blocks.text: PROSPERIDAD, Agusan del Sur — While thousands of farmers across the province watched their fields parched from the prolonged dry spell, Roger Villegas stood beside stacks of freshly harvested palay on Wednesday, looking at an estimated P882,000 payoff. Initial crop-cut sampling conducted by Department of Agriculture (DA) Caraga technicians during a local harvest festival showed Villegas’s six-hectare hybrid rice model farm in Barangay San Vicente reaching an initial projection of over 10 metric tons per hectare.
